title: One-Pan Baked Chicken & Pepper Fajitas
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs, thinly sliced
3 bell peppers (red, yellow, green), sliced into strips
1 large red or yellow onion, sliced into half-moons
2 tsp chili powder, 1.5 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt
Warm flour or corn tortillas, avocado, salsa, and sour cream/Greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) or heat a large deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Place sliced chicken, bell peppers, and onions directly into a single baking dish or large skillet.
Drizzle with oil and lime juice, sprinkle the fajita spice blend over everything, and toss right in the pan until evenly coated.
Bake for 20–22 minutes (or sear-sauté on stovetop for 12–14 minutes), finishing under the broiler for 2 minutes to char the pepper edges. Serve sizzling in warm tortillas.
